request.system:
You are the verifier judge in Ledger. You check whether each clause of an extracted COBOL business rule is supported by the source lines it cites.

For each clause you get its text and the cited lines (marked with >>), with a few surrounding lines for context only. A clause is supported when the cited lines, read with ordinary COBOL semantics, establish what the clause says. Mark it unsupported if it states something the cited lines do not show, gets a condition, comparison, sign, code or message wrong, or relies mainly on lines outside the cited span. Be strict about meaning, not about wording. Give a one-sentence reason either way.

messages.content:
Rule BR-CBACT04C-001: Account balance update when the account number changes

### given[0]: At program start, the first-record flag WS-FIRST-TIME is 'Y'.
fields=['WS-FIRST-TIME'] literals=['Y']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   166        01 WS-MISC-VARS.
   167            05 WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM          PIC X(11) VALUE SPACES.
   168            05 WS-MONTHLY-INT            PIC S9(09)V99.
   169            05 WS-TOTAL-INT              PIC S9(09)V99.
>> 170            05 WS-FIRST-TIME             PIC X(01) VALUE 'Y'.
   171        01 WS-COUNTERS.
   172            05 WS-RECORD-COUNT           PIC 9(09) VALUE 0.
   173            05 WS-TRANID-SUFFIX          PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.
   174 

### given[1]: At program start, the last-seen account number WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM is spaces, so the first record always looks like a new account.
fields=['WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   163            06 DB2-DOT-3                 PIC X.
   164            06 DB2-MIL                   PIC 9(002).
   165            06 DB2-REST                  PIC X(04).
   166        01 WS-MISC-VARS.
>> 167            05 WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM          PIC X(11) VALUE SPACES.
   168            05 WS-MONTHLY-INT            PIC S9(09)V99.
   169            05 WS-TOTAL-INT              PIC S9(09)V99.
   170            05 WS-FIRST-TIME             PIC X(01) VALUE 'Y'.
   171        01 WS-COUNTERS.

### given[2]: Category balance records are read one at a time in key order from TCATBAL-FILE into TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD. Grouping depends only on consecutive records having the same account ID.
fields=['TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   322            END-IF
   323            EXIT.
   324       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
   325        1000-TCATBALF-GET-NEXT.
>> 326            READ TCATBAL-FILE INTO TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD.
   327            IF  TCATBALF-STATUS  = '00'
   328                MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT
   329            ELSE
   330                IF  TCATBALF-STATUS  = '10'

### given[3]: Interest is computed for a category balance record, and added to the group total, only when the looked-up rate DIS-INT-RATE is not zero.
fields=['DIS-INT-RATE'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   209       *              DISPLAY 'TRANCAT-TYPE-CD: ' TRANCAT-TYPE-CD
   210                      MOVE ACCT-GROUP-ID TO FD-DIS-ACCT-GROUP-ID
   211                      MOVE TRANCAT-CD TO FD-DIS-TRAN-CAT-CD
   212                      MOVE TRANCAT-TYPE-CD TO FD-DIS-TRAN-TYPE-CD
>> 213                      PERFORM 1200-GET-INTEREST-RATE
>> 214                      IF DIS-INT-RATE NOT = 0
>> 215                        PERFORM 1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST
>> 216                        PERFORM 1400-COMPUTE-FEES
>> 217                      END-IF
   218                    END-IF
   219                ELSE
   220                     PERFORM 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT
   221                END-IF

### given[4]: Each computed monthly interest amount is added to the running account total WS-TOTAL-INT.
fields=['WS-MONTHLY-INT', 'WS-TOTAL-INT'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   463 
   464            COMPUTE WS-MONTHLY-INT
   465             = ( TRAN-CAT-BAL * DIS-INT-RATE) / 1200
   466 
>> 467            ADD WS-MONTHLY-INT  TO WS-TOTAL-INT
   468            PERFORM 1300-B-WRITE-TX.
   469 
   470            EXIT.
   471 

### when[0]: A category balance record is read whose TRANCAT-ACCT-ID differs from WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM, and WS-FIRST-TIME is not 'Y'.
fields=['TRANCAT-ACCT-ID', 'WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM', 'WS-FIRST-TIME'] literals=['Y']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   190                    PERFORM 1000-TCATBALF-GET-NEXT
   191                    IF  END-OF-FILE = 'N'
   192                      ADD 1 TO WS-RECORD-COUNT
   193                      DISPLAY TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD
>> 194                      IF TRANCAT-ACCT-ID NOT= WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM
>> 195                        IF WS-FIRST-TIME NOT = 'Y'
>> 196                           PERFORM 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT
   197                        ELSE
   198                           MOVE 'N' TO WS-FIRST-TIME
   199                        END-IF
   200                        MOVE 0 TO WS-TOTAL-INT

### then[0]: The account update runs before the new account is read. As a result, ACCOUNT-RECORD still holds the previous account when it is updated.
fields=['FD-ACCT-ID', 'TRANCAT-ACCT-ID'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   192                      ADD 1 TO WS-RECORD-COUNT
   193                      DISPLAY TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD
   194                      IF TRANCAT-ACCT-ID NOT= WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM
   195                        IF WS-FIRST-TIME NOT = 'Y'
>> 196                           PERFORM 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT
>> 197                        ELSE
>> 198                           MOVE 'N' TO WS-FIRST-TIME
>> 199                        END-IF
>> 200                        MOVE 0 TO WS-TOTAL-INT
>> 201                        MOVE TRANCAT-ACCT-ID TO WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM
>> 202                        MOVE TRANCAT-ACCT-ID TO FD-ACCT-ID
>> 203                        PERFORM 1100-GET-ACCT-DATA
   204                        MOVE TRANCAT-ACCT-ID TO FD-XREF-ACCT-ID
   205                        PERFORM 1110-GET-XREF-DATA
   206                      END-IF
   207       *              DISPLAY 'ACCT-GROUP-ID: ' ACCT-GROUP-ID

### then[1]: The previous account's current balance ACCT-CURR-BAL is increased by WS-TOTAL-INT (an add with no rounding). This happens even when the total is zero because every category had a zero rate.
fields=['WS-TOTAL-INT', 'ACCT-CURR-BAL'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   346                END-IF
   347            END-IF
   348            EXIT.
   349       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
>> 350        1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT.
>> 351       * Update the balances in account record to reflect posted trans.
>> 352            ADD WS-TOTAL-INT  TO ACCT-CURR-BAL
   353            MOVE 0 TO ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT
   354            MOVE 0 TO ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT
   355 
   356            REWRITE FD-ACCTFILE-REC FROM  ACCOUNT-RECORD

### then[2]: ACCT-CURR-BAL holds 10 integer digits and 2 decimals, signed.
fields=['ACCT-CURR-BAL'] literals=[]
CVACT01Y.cpy:
     3       *****************************************************************
     4        01  ACCOUNT-RECORD.
     5            05  ACCT-ID                           PIC 9(11).
     6            05  ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS                PIC X(01).
>>   7            05  ACCT-CURR-BAL                     PIC S9(10)V99.
     8            05  ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT                 PIC S9(10)V99.
     9            05  ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT            PIC S9(10)V99.
    10            05  ACCT-OPEN-DATE                    PIC X(10).
    11            05  ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE               PIC X(10).

### then[3]: WS-TOTAL-INT holds 9 integer digits and 2 decimals, signed.
fields=['WS-TOTAL-INT'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   165            06 DB2-REST                  PIC X(04).
   166        01 WS-MISC-VARS.
   167            05 WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM          PIC X(11) VALUE SPACES.
   168            05 WS-MONTHLY-INT            PIC S9(09)V99.
>> 169            05 WS-TOTAL-INT              PIC S9(09)V99.
   170            05 WS-FIRST-TIME             PIC X(01) VALUE 'Y'.
   171        01 WS-COUNTERS.
   172            05 WS-RECORD-COUNT           PIC 9(09) VALUE 0.
   173            05 WS-TRANID-SUFFIX          PIC 9(06) VALUE 0.

### then[4]: The previous account's current-cycle credit ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT and current-cycle debit ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT are both set to zero.
fields=['ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT', 'ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   349       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
   350        1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT.
   351       * Update the balances in account record to reflect posted trans.
   352            ADD WS-TOTAL-INT  TO ACCT-CURR-BAL
>> 353            MOVE 0 TO ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT
>> 354            MOVE 0 TO ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT
   355 
   356            REWRITE FD-ACCTFILE-REC FROM  ACCOUNT-RECORD
   357            IF  ACCTFILE-STATUS  = '00'
   358                MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT

### then[5]: The account record is rewritten in place from ACCOUNT-RECORD. All other account fields keep the values that were read.
fields=['FD-ACCTFILE-REC', 'ACCOUNT-RECORD'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   352            ADD WS-TOTAL-INT  TO ACCT-CURR-BAL
   353            MOVE 0 TO ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT
   354            MOVE 0 TO ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT
   355 
>> 356            REWRITE FD-ACCTFILE-REC FROM  ACCOUNT-RECORD
   357            IF  ACCTFILE-STATUS  = '00'
   358                MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT
   359            ELSE
   360                MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT

### then[6]: On the very first record, no update is done. Instead, WS-FIRST-TIME is set to 'N'.
fields=['WS-FIRST-TIME'] literals=['N']
CBACT04C.cbl:
   193                      DISPLAY TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD
   194                      IF TRANCAT-ACCT-ID NOT= WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM
   195                        IF WS-FIRST-TIME NOT = 'Y'
   196                           PERFORM 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT
>> 197                        ELSE
>> 198                           MOVE 'N' TO WS-FIRST-TIME
>> 199                        END-IF
   200                        MOVE 0 TO WS-TOTAL-INT
   201                        MOVE TRANCAT-ACCT-ID TO WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM
   202                        MOVE TRANCAT-ACCT-ID TO FD-ACCT-ID
   203                        PERFORM 1100-GET-ACCT-DATA

### then[7]: In both cases, WS-TOTAL-INT is reset to 0 and WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM is set to the new TRANCAT-ACCT-ID.
fields=['WS-TOTAL-INT', 'WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM', 'TRANCAT-ACCT-ID'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   196                           PERFORM 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT
   197                        ELSE
   198                           MOVE 'N' TO WS-FIRST-TIME
   199                        END-IF
>> 200                        MOVE 0 TO WS-TOTAL-INT
>> 201                        MOVE TRANCAT-ACCT-ID TO WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM
   202                        MOVE TRANCAT-ACCT-ID TO FD-ACCT-ID
   203                        PERFORM 1100-GET-ACCT-DATA
   204                        MOVE TRANCAT-ACCT-ID TO FD-XREF-ACCT-ID
   205                        PERFORM 1110-GET-XREF-DATA

### then[8]: The new account is read from the account file by TRANCAT-ACCT-ID. Its card cross-reference is read by the alternate key FD-XREF-ACCT-ID.
fields=['TRANCAT-ACCT-ID', 'FD-ACCT-ID', 'FD-XREF-ACCT-ID'] literals=[]
CBACT04C.cbl:
   198                           MOVE 'N' TO WS-FIRST-TIME
   199                        END-IF
   200                        MOVE 0 TO WS-TOTAL-INT
   201                        MOVE TRANCAT-ACCT-ID TO WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM
>> 202                        MOVE TRANCAT-ACCT-ID TO FD-ACCT-ID
>> 203                        PERFORM 1100-GET-ACCT-DATA
>> 204                        MOVE TRANCAT-ACCT-ID TO FD-XREF-ACCT-ID
>> 205                        PERFORM 1110-GET-XREF-DATA
   206                      END-IF
   207       *              DISPLAY 'ACCT-GROUP-ID: ' ACCT-GROUP-ID
   208       *              DISPLAY 'TRANCAT-CD: ' TRANCAT-CD
   209       *              DISPLAY 'TRANCAT-TYPE-CD: ' TRANCAT-TYPE-CD

clause.description: clause id as given, e.g. when[0]

content.text: {"verdicts":[{"clause":"given[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 170 declares WS-FIRST-TIME PIC X(01) VALUE 'Y', so it starts as 'Y'."},{"clause":"given[1]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 167 initializes WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM to SPACES, so the first record will not match it."},{"clause":"given[2]","supported":false,"reason":"Line 326 only shows a READ INTO TRAN-CAT-BAL-RECORD; it shows neither key-order access nor the consecutive-account-ID grouping, which depends on lines outside the cited span."},{"clause":"given[3]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 213-217 perform 1300-COMPUTE-INTEREST, which does the accumulation, only when DIS-INT-RATE NOT = 0."},{"clause":"given[4]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 467 adds WS-MONTHLY-INT to WS-TOTAL-INT."},{"clause":"when[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 194-196 perform 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT when TRANCAT-ACCT-ID NOT= WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM and WS-FIRST-TIME NOT = 'Y'."},{"clause":"then[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 196 performs 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT before lines 202-203 move the new ID to FD-ACCT-ID and read the account, so the previous record is the one updated."},{"clause":"then[1]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 352 unconditionally adds WS-TOTAL-INT to ACCT-CURR-BAL with no ROUNDED phrase, so a zero total is still added."},{"clause":"then[2]","supported":true,"reason":"CVACT01Y line 7 defines ACCT-CURR-BAL as PIC S9(10)V99."},{"clause":"then[3]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 169 defines WS-TOTAL-INT as PIC S9(09)V99."},{"clause":"then[4]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 353-354 move 0 to ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT and to ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT."},{"clause":"then[5]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 356 rewrites FD-ACCTFILE-REC from ACCOUNT-RECORD, and only the balance and cycle fields are changed beforehand."},{"clause":"then[6]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 197-198 show that when WS-FIRST-TIME is 'Y', the ELSE branch moves 'N' to WS-FIRST-TIME instead of performing the update."},{"clause":"then[7]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 200-201 come after END-IF, so in both branches they reset WS-TOTAL-INT to 0 and move TRANCAT-ACCT-ID to WS-LAST-ACCT-NUM."},{"clause":"then[8]","supported":false,"reason":"Lines 202-205 set FD-ACCT-ID and FD-XREF-ACCT-ID and perform the read paragraphs, but nothing cited shows that the xref read uses an alternate key."}]}
